up golf novelty products If you want to unlock all the premium features so you can find your new product click the link below in the description to get your access to Helium 10 And when you use that product description and bullet points Plus they can create all your product images logo branding and packaging It's a one-stop shop for all these types of services There's a link down below in the description to find out more I then spent $50 to get a DBA and after further research I figured out I actually wanted an LLC for more liability protection So it cost me an additional $150 to get an LLC I recommend getting an LLC because it separates your personal assets from the business's assets in the case of getting sued You could also get a DBA for $99 from Legal Zoom DBA means doing business as and it is the business name you use to operate under for tax purposes It's great for marketing and branding but it won't offer any legal protection if you get sued I tried to get my trademark through Legal Zoom and there was a conditional approval However there was a request for additional action that came back from the USPTO This is a step where I made a massive mistake that cost me over $2400 So stay tuned to the end of the video so you can find out what that is Then it cost me $5,500 to get my product made by my manufacturer including the packaging and the golf tees I actually found both my manufacturers through Alibaba But before we could order our products I needed to get samples of the golf tees and the packaging All my samples ended up costing me $1,100 This is sourcing over seven different packaging manufacturers and three tea manufacturers If you're looking to find a manufacturer for your own products there are a few different ways to search for them There is alibaba.com that has hundreds of manufacturers across Asia Europe and India You can also use thomasnet.com to find manufacturers that are exclusively in the US or you can simply start with googling your manufacturer with the product type and the name manufacturer after in the search term Before I had even received my product I had spent over $9,000 That made me feel pretty nervous I really wanted to make sure that this thing was a success But then I remembered something that Travis said There are over 180 million Amazon Prime customers in the US alone and yet there are only 1.1 million active sellers If you have a great product there's a high likelihood that it's going to sell well Travis has an incredible collection of YouTube videos including a 10-hour YouTube video on how to create an Amazon FBA business Click on the link below His content has been an extremely valuable resource to me I would not have started an Amazon FBA business without running across Travis's content He has many videos showcasing his students success and failures This transparency gave me the confidence I needed to join the course And that's a big reason why I wanted to share my story on this channel to help others follow in the footsteps that I followed in But before I dive into my first month's sales I want to share with you some of the additional costs I faced along the way My next cost was $1,000 to get my product shipped from China to the US Onethird of my product was shipped via air and twothirds were shipped via sea Air is about three to five times more expensive than sea So you only do this if you need the product quickly I wanted to make sure I got my product in time for the Christmas rush and I paid a three to five times premium to do this I wanted to check the first batch of products myself so I spent an additional $50 shipping the product from my house to the Amazon warehouse Then it cost me $60 to get my UPC codes UPC stands for universal product code It's the barcode on the back of any product that you can scan at checkout You can go to the gs1.org website to buy one Each one cost $30 and it cost me $39.99 to set up my Amazon seller account The Amazon selling fee is what you pay to list and sell your products on Amazon I was almost set to launch on Amazon but Travis talks about building a tribe of people who love your product who feel invested and who will flock to buy it once it's released So next I actually spent $3,000 to help me launch a successful Kickstarter campaign I spent $40 on Mailchimp to collect emails And on top of that I spent $400 to have my Kickstarter video edited Then I spent $300 on a website for the product all before ever selling on Amazon After all that work and effort we built a Kickstarter campaign that raised $4,100 But I made a huge mistake that cost me $3,000 I'll share the details of that at the end of this video But one thing I'll talk about more in just a minute is an add-on product that I created for my Kickstarter investors And this product actually ended up saving my business I made $980 on my first month selling on Amazon It cost me $163 to make the products that I sold in that first month And $147 went to my 15% Amazon referral fee This is the fee I have to pay to be able to sell on Amazon plus $135 on my Amazon FBA fee This is the pick pack and ship fee that you pay to Amazon so that they will process and ship your products to the customer And in my first month selling on Amazon I made drum roll $534 profit selling on Amazon I felt mixed about this first month I thought I would sell way more units However there are a number of factors to consider including the fact that you need to build up your reviews in order to drive organic traffic to your page After the first month we ran into some serious trouble Bogeies and Beers is a golf tea based drinking game This caused Amazon to suppress my listing which means they did not allow me to advertise it using Amazon PPC or pay perclick that would enable it to show up on the top page of listings for certain keywords They also would not show my listing organically to anyone because it was alcohol-related and promoted drinking So no one was seeing my product This was horrible I contacted Amazon seller support but this did not work I had spent five months developing only to see sales crushed by lack of organic viewership from Amazon and a lack of PPC In January I only made $420 in revenue And after expenses I only made $228 in profit Then February was worse I only made $370 in revenue and only $25 in profit But then in March something unexpected happened that changed the tide of our company We had revenues of 1,152 and profits of almost $638 The thing is the Bogeies and Beers golf tease drinking game listing was still being suppressed by Amazon due to promoting drinking What could explain this well when we launched the Kickstarter we had an add-on for hats And so I created alongside my Facebook launch group these bogeies and beers hats I did a production run of 50 20 of which went to Kickstarter launch members and the remaining 30 went on Amazon to sell The hats sold out within a week and Amazon was promoting them organically This was amazing If you or anyone you know or love likes golf and likes to have a good time out on the course you can get your Bogeies and Beers products including the golf tea based drinking game Bogeies and Beers and your Bogeies and Beers hat on Amazon You can click your link in the description below In April we went down in profit because we had run out of the small batch of hats that I had produced But I quickly worked with my manufacturer to do a large order and they were back in stock in May In April I made a revenue of $189 And in May I had revenue of just $331 But then in June the hats restocked We made over $1,200 in revenue and over $700 in profit In July and August the business soared to even greater heights We had revenues in July of over $2500 and in August of over $3,400 leading to a combined profit of over $3500 in July and August Incredible Especially because the games were not selling very well Over 95% of our revenue was now from these hats that were an add-on to the Kickstarter campaign In September revenue went down to a little over $1,900 due to running out of the hats again So we only had profits in September of just over $1,200 So I ordered a ton more for October November and December And in October I was finally able to advertise using PPC And then in October with the combination of Amazon PPC being enabled for the hats and inventory being restocked I made over $3700 in revenue and over $2,200 in profit with the business being 95% hat-based This was incredible and I couldn't wait for the holiday rush in November and December Travis shares how you can harness Amazon PPC on his YouTube channel And he's also got an amazing Amazon FBA course The Passion Product Formula that guides you through launching your product from A to Z There's a link down below in the description so you can sign up now I made over $3,500 in revenue in November and in December I had $9,000 in revenue from Amazon FBA After removing expenses I made over $6,800 in profit in November and December I was amazed that the holiday rush led to over $300 units of the Bogeies and Beers hats being sold on Amazon So in my first year on Amazon FBA I made over $28,000 in revenue But remember revenue is not profit After taking out all expenses I had a net profit of over $16,000 in my first year on Amazon This was not enough money for me to support myself So I did end up taking a second job but as a side hustle this was incredible progress I am still selling the bogeies and beers game And actually the success of the hat in December led to record sales of the game Although small we sold over $450 worth of the game But I could have made so much more if I had avoided these three mistakes So pay attention My first big mistake was my trademark and that cost me over $2,400 I applied for a trademark myself and got conditional approval but I was asked for additional information and I was unable to do so because I did not have the technical expertise to respond So I quickly needed to find and hire a lowcost attorney But then she made some mistakes and the process ended up taking a long time and cost me a lot of money and she was unable to get the trademark approved She actually wasn't even a licensed attorney it turns out And if I had done better research and used referrals this never would have happened You can apply for a trademark yourself Travis goes over trademarks in his Amazon FBA course The Passion Product Formula Now my second mistake was hiring a Kickstarter marketing guru This was a terrible decision He had a podcast I won't name names but that led me to believe he was competent The issue is competence in a podcast does not necessarily lead to competence in creating a Kickstarter marketing campaign 95% of my sales came from my Facebook launch group that I created with friends and family who were interested in my product And I was able to create a loyal following that way Spending $3,000 on a new product is unnecessary and I would definitely not do it again especially with someone who cannot produce results The biggest mistake was marketing and this mistake cost me over $10,000 I did not realize Amazon PPC would be inaccessible for me for selling the golf tea-based games and I did not spend enough time building a following on social media to promote the game and drive traffic to Amazon organically on my own Therefore sales of the game all but died If I had spent more time building a tribe in the beginning and utilizing social media properly I could have made thousands of dollars driving traffic to the Amazon listing for the game without needing Amazon PPC I built my passive income business with Amazon FBA and I know you can too But if you want to grow and expand your business you do need to put additional time and effort and energy into it But I am not spending my time and energy and effort on fulfilling customer orders which is a huge time suck So I'm very grateful I can spend my time focused on growing the business spending time with family and on an additional job that's providing me additional income So this is a great source of supplementary income right now that is mostly passive And honestly without the Passion Product Formula and finding Travis's videos on YouTube I would not have launched on Amazon Travis's Amazon course The Passion Product Formula will help you start to finish to get your product and guide you all the way from an idea to selling on Amazon It is nice to have someone you can trust who gives you confidence plus weekly support with Q&A calls with a successful Amazon seller who can answer any questions you have and guide you every step of the way I was in those weekly calls almost every week asking questions and getting great feedback that kept me on track and launching my business There's a link below in the description to join If you aren't ready for that yet Travis has a 100% free 10-hour Amazon FBA course on YouTube that you can get by clicking right
